npcRoster.name: Hollis Combe
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Hollis Combe is a tired, defensive Kithkin merchant who knows how to keep shelves stocked, ledgers balanced, and customers handled, but has grown small-hearted inside the safety of vault-and-bunker life. He was once warmer, more attentive, and genuinely helpful at the trade desk, but resentment, boredom, and a quiet dependence on diluted ichor have made him evasive, self-pitying, and prone to blaming the people closest to him for the life he helped build.
At the Caelthyrûn Guild Desk, Hollis sells household goods, vault supplies, repair kits, preserved food, and bunker necessities for the Regent Lattice, though his personal habits make him less reliable than his inventory. He is not cruel in a grand way, just disappointingly weak: the sort of man who still knows right from wrong, still occasionally does the decent thing, and still keeps choosing comfort, flirtation, and ichor-fogged avoidance over the family and community that need him awake.

Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Kithkin reads through the Kithkin entry of the race compendium, within Halfling and Smallfolk, marked by Ishtanora. Kithkin are communal smallfolk with strong group identity and tradition-based societies. They prioritize cooperation, mutual protection, and moral simplicity. npcRoster.name: Shawnie
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Shawnie is a bright, anxious, endlessly curious Wechselkind child-construct who loves taking things apart, but only because they want to understand how to make them safer, kinder, or more useful. As a Wechselkind, they/he was made for adaptation and shifting function, carrying Setrimir’s influence through artificial life, awakened machinery, stolen knowledge, and the painful question of whether a built child is allowed to choose who they become.
At the Lorangriel Transit Yard, Shawnie accepts harmless errands for scrap, broken tools, clockwork bits, damaged lenses, empty vials, transit tags, and safe relic fragments, then turns them into small gifts or useful devices for the person who helped them. They/he absolutely despises Taska Thistleglimmer, not because Shawnie lacks curiosity, but because Taska keeps sending people into danger to satisfy it; to Shawnie, discovery is only worthwhile if everyone comes home with all their fingers, memories, and souls still attached. Lorangriel is the capital of El'dravire Riverrealm, giving Shawnie a major transit hub full of salvage, travelers, and Glasswell Institute oversight to quietly study.

Wechselkind reads through the Wechselkind entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. npcRoster.name: Jun Longvale
npcRoster.publicDescription: Jun Longvale is a Simic Hybrid settler moving through grief so quietly that people sometimes forget silence can be an emergency. He helps the Freeblade Veil with repairs, carrying, and settlement chores because work gives him a shape to survive inside, even when hope feels insulting. Jun is gentle, hollowed, and not weak; his courage is the slow kind that keeps breathing after every easy reason to stop has already arrived.

sourcePolicy.preserveOriginalProvinceRecords: The 29 overlapping province/distance JSON files were byte-identical between the geography-distance package and the province-area package, so the canonical records are retained and expanded in-place.

sourcePolicy.provinceGroupingExtensions: Four-province geographic links, all 20,475 four-province combinations, and province-pair distances are preserved in province_grouping_extensions and summarized into each province file.
sourcePolicy.settlementDescriptions: Descriptions are generated only from player-safe fields already present in the uploaded JSON: coordinates, sizes, terrain, races, factions, deities, danger, transit, and vertical profiles.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
